User asks "1510年的法国国王是谁?" They want the king of France in 1510.

We can answer directly: In 1510, Henry II was King of France (reigned 1547? Wait check). Actually Henry II reigned from 1559 to 1572. So not him. Let's recall French monarchy timeline:

Louis XII reigned until 1515; before that Louis XI died 1483. After Louis XII's death on March 1, 1515, his son Francis I became king. But in 1510, still under Louis XII. He had been king since 1498. So answer: Louis XII.

But we might also mention he was known as Louis XII of France, born 1473, died 1525. Provide context maybe.
